extension.summary: Watch Twitch with a TV layout
extension.description: Watch live channels, past broadcasts and clips from Twitch, in Kodi's own folders or in a full-screen TV interface. Sign in with a code at twitch.tv/activate to see the channels you follow; Turbo and subscriber benefits come with the sign-in.
extension.news: v4.0.0~alpha1 - New add-on built around a TV layout: Home, Following, Categories, channels and search - Sign in with a code at twitch.tv/activate, with multiple accounts - Live, past broadcast and clip playback through InputStream Adaptive
